value.cardTitle: Track F: PostGIS Spatial & Proximity API Implementation
value.summary: Implemented server-side PostGIS spatial utilities (Haversine distance, bounding box, RFC 7946 GeoJSON) and dual endpoints: dedicated GET /api/listings/spatial and extended GET /api/listings?lat=...&lng=...&radiusKm=... backed by the 9,534 geocoded Supabase listings. All 10 unit tests in listings-spatial.test.ts passing, type check clean, security boundaries verified.
value.residualNotes: Pushed to origin/main. Working tree clean. Next phase can connect spatial endpoints to client-side map UI or recommendation feeds.
